title: Stock photos load again (the door cards' photos)
why: The home page's door cards (Let's Explore, Get Local) and other stock-library photos showed only their credit: their /uploads/system/... addresses gave a 404. website/uploads/.htaccess hands a photo that isn't on the server to media.php (decisions/0123), but that rule was written by hand and lists members, businesses, guests and orders, not system (the stock library, decisions/0143). Member, business and older photos were fine. Now the site writes the rule itself from Store::KINDS, and stock photos are given an address that works even without it.
proposals: decisions/0123 (public photos keep their /uploads/ address), decisions/0143

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
